name: Butterfly Counting and (alpha,beta)-Core Decomposition on Bipartite Graphs
problem_statement: Given a bipartite graph, count butterflies (complete 2x2 bicliques) globally and per vertex/edge, and optionally compute maximal vertex sets satisfying separate left/right thresholds. core_measure explicitly distinguishes conventional degree-based (alpha,beta)-cores from the butterfly-participation variant.

normalization: Reject edges whose endpoints share the same declared side.
Remove self-loops (impossible in valid bipartite input; reject if present).
Collapse parallel edges between the same pair to one edge.
Every vertex must have a side label in {left, right}; isolated vertices on either side are retained.

problem_inputs.name: mode
problem_inputs.description: Return a global count, per-vertex/per-edge participation counts, or a full (alpha,beta)-core decomposition.

problem_inputs.name: alpha
problem_inputs.description: Left-side degeneracy parameter when mode=alpha_beta_core; null means decompose for all feasible alpha.

problem_inputs.name: beta
problem_inputs.description: Right-side degeneracy parameter when mode=alpha_beta_core; null means decompose for all feasible beta.

problem_inputs.name: core_measure
problem_inputs.description: In alpha_beta_core mode, apply side-specific thresholds to induced butterfly participation or ordinary induced vertex degree. The former preserves this collection's original contract; the latter is the conventional (alpha,beta)-core definition.

problem_inputs.name: solution_quality
problem_inputs.description: Whether a sampling-based approximate butterfly count with a disclosed bound is permitted.

required_outputs.name: butterfly_count
required_outputs.description: Total number of distinct butterflies (unordered 2x2 complete bipartite subgraphs) in the graph.

required_outputs.name: complete
required_outputs.description: Whether the count/decomposition covers the entire input graph without sampling truncation.

optional_outputs.name: per_vertex_butterfly_count
optional_outputs.description: Butterflies each vertex participates in; present when mode=per_vertex.

optional_outputs.name: per_edge_butterfly_count
optional_outputs.description: Butterflies each edge (as a wedge pair) participates in; present when mode=per_edge.

optional_outputs.name: alpha_beta_core_assignment
optional_outputs.description: Per-vertex maximal (alpha,beta) coordinates; present when mode=alpha_beta_core.

optional_outputs.name: approximation_bound
optional_outputs.description: Certified relative error bound for an approximate count.

solution_semantics.objective: Enumerate or count every 4-cycle formed by two left vertices and two right vertices that are all pairwise connected (a butterfly), with no induced-subgraph requirement beyond the four required edges.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact mode requires every butterfly to be counted exactly once; approximate mode must disclose its bound.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each unordered set of 2 left + 2 right vertices forming a butterfly is counted once regardless of discovery order.
solution_semantics.ordering: Not applicable for global count; per_vertex and per_edge outputs are unordered maps.

validation_rules: butterfly_count recomputes from the normalized bipartite adjacency via independent wedge-based counting.
Sum of per_vertex_butterfly_count over one side, divided by 2, is internally consistent with butterfly_count.
Core vertices retain at least alpha (left) or beta (right) units of the declared core_measure within the induced core; the returned vertex set is the largest satisfying those thresholds.
No edge with same-side endpoints is present in the normalized graph.
edge_cases: A graph with no 4-cycles has butterfly_count zero.
A complete bipartite graph K(m,n) has the closed-form C(m,2)*C(n,2) butterflies, usable as a correctness check.
Isolated vertices contribute zero to every count.

With butterfly_participation, the (1,1)-core contains vertices participating in at least one butterfly. With degree, it contains the nonisolated vertices, including vertices in graphs with no butterflies.

correctness: exact count agreement with brute-force wedge oracle on small/medium fixtures
